pullRequest.title: [P0-47] Snapshot frozen files on edit so restoration parity proofs stop blocking plan work (D-15)
pullRequest.body:
Proposed plan issue **P0-47**: implements Sid's decision **D-15 ("snapshot on edit", 2026-10-05)** from the [AMC Ready-to-Deploy Implementation Plan](https://claude.ai/code/artifact/153157e0-0d2f-4374-934b-5f6f360a46e1). **Stacked on #34** (P0-01): its base branch is `rtd/p0-01-contract-receipts-freeze` because P0-01 edits four of the same parity tests.

> **Merge note:** merge #34 with **"Create a merge commit"**, not squash, then this PR. The snapshot entry records `baseCommit` `51f425bf` (#34's head), and `tests/planEditsManifest.test.ts` requires it to stay an ancestor of `HEAD`. After a squash, rerun `scripts/snapshot-plan-edit.mjs` with the new base (see `unused-code/plan-edits/README.md`).

## Why

The root patch landed on `main` (786d8abb) added restoration parity tests. They compare live files byte for byte with archives under `unused-code/`, which freezes about 190 files: `src/types.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/sdk/nativeAgentClient.ts`, `src/workspace.ts`, built `dist/*.d.ts` and the text of other tests. That blocks P0-06 (shell gate) and P0-08 (claim service), which must edit those files.

## What changes

- **`tests/helpers/landedSource.ts`.** `landedBytes`/`landedText` return the archived pre-edit bytes for a path registered in `unused-code/plan-edits/manifest.json`, after verifying their sha256, and otherwise return the live file.
- **19 parity test files** route every *live freeze-comparison* read through the helper. Archive reads and behaviour reads are unchanged: the tests still import and run live code, and there is no `node:fs` mock. The other 10 files have no live freeze read.
- **`scripts/snapshot-plan-edit.mjs --issue <KEY> --base <rev> <path>...`** archives `git cat-file blob <rev>:<path>` and upserts the sorted manifest. For a source file it also archives the pinned `dist/` outputs from disk, but only while they still equal their pins.
  - It refuses: a duplicate path, a bad key, a path that is not a file at `<rev>`, an already-rebuilt `dist/` output, and `package.json`, which P0-01 pins by entries.
- **`tests/planEditsManifest.test.ts`** checks:
  - Schema, sort order and uniqueness, and that each archive's sha256 matches.
  - Each archive equals `<baseCommit>:<path>`, and the base is an ancestor of `HEAD`. This is skipped only in a shallow clone that lacks the base.
  - Helper units, and script behaviour in temp git repositories.
- **Meta-freeze.** This PR edits `tests/privateModuleHelperVisibility.test.ts`, whose text `workspacePathRedactionParity` freezes. Its pre-edit bytes are therefore registered under `P0-47`, which is the one manifest entry.
- `unused-code/plan-edits/README.md` documents how to use it. The patch changeset is worded "contributor tooling only, no runtime change".

## Acceptance checklist

- [x] The parity tests pass as before. 7,098 parity tests at the base and 7,098 + 10 new after. With an *empty* manifest only one assertion fails: the meta-freeze of the test file this PR edits, which its own committed entry covers.
- [x] Integration proof for `src/types.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/sdk/nativeAgentClient.ts` and `src/workspace.ts`. Each got a probe that changes declarations (`export const p47Probe = 1;`), followed by a `dist/` rebuild. Each probe failed the parity suite (3, 3, 3 and 2 failures) and passed after `snapshot-plan-edit.mjs --issue P0-99`. All probes were reverted.
- [x] Manifest and helper tests pass. Mutation checks:
  - `landedBytes` always reading the live file fails the integration proof plus 5 helper and script tests.
  - Skipping the sha256 check fails "throws when an archive no longer matches its manifest sha256".
- [x] No archive read was rerouted and no `node:fs` mock was added.
- [x] Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests and lint pass (local run below); changeset added.

**Full local run of every CI step at `975d3723`:**
- 1,525 test files, 21,457/21,457 tests passed under coverage; per-file floors pass.
- clean-source, packed-install and e2e smoke pass.
- `release:gate` 17/19. Only `source-duplicates` and `source-dead-code` fail, as on `main` (D-11).
- `git status` was empty after the run.

Knip first reported 3 new findings (exported constants used only inside their own modules). The last commit makes them module-private, which brings Knip back to 2,339, the base count. Duplicates are unchanged at 1,253. Focused tests, typecheck:tests and lint were rerun after that commit.

## Review

Three lenses raised 8 findings and refuters checked each one. Seven were confirmed and fixed with regression tests:

- **(high)** Built `dist/*.d.ts` pins in `metricParameterContractParity` and `workspacePathRedactionParity` would still block P0-06 and P0-08 once CI rebuilt `dist/`. Pinned build outputs are now snapshotted too.
- A squash-rewritten `baseCommit` now fails clearly instead of being skipped.
- The script ran nothing when invoked through a symlink, and it accepted a directory as a path.
- The script and validator now refuse `package.json`.

## Limits

D-15 only frees *freeze comparisons*. Behaviour checks still run live code, so an edit that really changes the behaviour of a module those tests execute still fails them. That is intended, and P0-06 and P0-08 handle it per issue.

recoveredAcceptance: Preserve all existing parity assertions; compare the same full original source/declaration/archive bytes.

Four real declaration-changing source probes: src/types.ts, src/index.ts, src/sdk/nativeAgentClient.ts, src/workspace.ts; each adds export const p47Probe = 1; and rebuilds dist. Each must fail without its snapshot and pass after snapshot registration, then be reverted in an owned fixture.
Manifest schema/sort/uniqueness/archive SHA/base ancestry checks, helper units, and actual script behavior must pass.
An actual helper mutation that always reads live files must fail integration and helper/script tests; an actual SHA-guard removal must fail the tampered-archive test.
Archive reads and behavior reads remain unchanged; behavior executes live code; no node:fs mock.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests and lint pass. Retain changeset; do not weaken any global or per-file coverage floor.

qualificationInterpretation.existingSnapshots: All four probe source paths are already registered on accepted main. Their historical archives and existing issue owners must remain intact. A direct P0-99 re-registration correctly refuses, and current-main probe source changes already read snapshots for freeze comparisons.
qualificationInterpretation.reproduction: Replay the original red-before/pass-after mechanism in disposable detached worktrees at b552b69cd220d7d73b63a58685f77bb2bbb26c8f, where only the original P0-47 meta-freeze is registered. Use exact current snapshot script/helper bytes as the tooling under qualification; leave historical parity assertions, source, manifests and archives unchanged except the explicitly owned probe and added snapshot rows.
qualificationInterpretation.proofSeparation: A historical fixture replay is integration evidence for current tooling against the unregistered frozen baseline. It is not a full-suite pass on current main. Current-main helper/manifest/parity/full-suite checks and current guard mutations must be separately recorded.
qualificationInterpretation.behavior: Real behavior changes may still fail parity after snapshot registration; a snapshot must never suppress those behavior failures.
qualificationInterpretation.packageJson: Keep approved package.json snapshot support and its current P0-09 archive. Do not restore the PR body's obsolete refusal.

missingAuthoritativeDetails: No dedicated specs/P0-47.md exists in the recovered specs inventory; merged PR #38 plus D-15 decisions are the recovered authority.

PR #38 names four probes, their one-line edit and historical failure counts (3,3,3,2), but no committed executable real-probe runner or retained per-probe raw logs/JSON receipts were found. These historical counts are not fresh evidence.
The linked Claude artifact has not been read directly; the locally recovered D-15 text records option A and references PR #38.
There is no approved instruction to delete/reassign existing snapshots on current main. Current-main red-before reproduction cannot be claimed by silently removing registered downstream archives.

commands.phase: Current-main baseline, in a fresh owned checkout at acceptedMain; run Node 22 and Node 24 in separate owned checkouts
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH"
export GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 5ea5e866a42acd5c8228a712e9b8c1d9f18c745c
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
mkdir -p tmp/p0-47
npm run build > tmp/p0-47/build.log 2>&1
npx --no-install vitest run tests/planEditsManifest.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/helper-manifest.json > tmp/p0-47/helper-manifest.log 2>&1
npx --no-install vitest run $(git grep -l 'unused-code/' -- tests | rg '\.test\.ts$') --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/parity.json > tmp/p0-47/parity.log 2>&1
npm run typecheck > tmp/p0-47/typecheck.log 2>&1
npm run typecheck:tests > tmp/p0-47/typecheck-tests.log 2>&1
npm run lint > tmp/p0-47/lint.log 2>&1
npm run check:freeze > tmp/p0-47/freeze.log 2>&1
npm run check:clean-source > tmp/p0-47/clean-source.log 2>&1
npm run test:coverage -- --exclude 'tests/performance/**' --coverage.reportOnFailure --reporter=default --reporter=json --reporter=hanging-process --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/full-tests.json > tmp/p0-47/full-tests.log 2>&1
npx --no-install vitest run tests/performance --no-file-parallelism --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/performance.json > tmp/p0-47/performance.log 2>&1
npm run check:coverage > tmp/p0-47/per-file-coverage.log 2>&1
git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all > tmp/p0-47/after-tests.txt
test ! -s tmp/p0-47/after-tests.txt
commands.note: For Node 24 use /opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin in a separate owned checkout with a fresh frozen install. Every check must retain its actual exit code. Do not describe full test success from passed case counts alone: JSON success must be true, failures/pending/todo must be zero, and global and per-file coverage must pass.

commands.phase: Four real source/declaration probes on the historical unregistered baseline, with current approved tooling
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH"
export GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1
p47_repo=/Users/sid/.codex/worktrees/p0-29-qualification/AgentMaturityCompass
p47_main=5ea5e866a42acd5c8228a712e9b8c1d9f18c745c
p47_base=b552b69cd220d7d73b63a58685f77bb2bbb26c8f
p47_runroot=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/amc-p0-47-probes-20261014.XXXXXX)
for p47_source in src/types.ts src/index.ts src/sdk/nativeAgentClient.ts src/workspace.ts; do
  p47_slug=$(printf '%s' "$p47_source" | tr '/.' '--')
  p47_fixture="$p47_runroot/$p47_slug"
  git -C "$p47_repo" worktree add --detach "$p47_fixture" "$p47_base"
  for p47_tool in scripts/snapshot-plan-edit.mjs tests/helpers/landedSource.ts tests/planEditsManifest.test.ts; do
    git -C "$p47_repo" show "$p47_main:$p47_tool" > "$p47_fixture/$p47_tool"
  done
  (
    cd "$p47_fixture"
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    mkdir -p tmp/p0-47
    npm run build > tmp/p0-47/base-build.log 2>&1
    npx --no-install vitest run $(git grep -l 'unused-code/' -- tests | rg '\.test\.ts$') --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/baseline.json > tmp/p0-47/baseline.log 2>&1
    printf '\nexport const p47Probe = 1;\n' >> "$p47_source"
    npm run build > tmp/p0-47/red-build.log 2>&1
    set +e
    npx --no-install vitest run $(git grep -l 'unused-code/' -- tests | rg '\.test\.ts$') --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/red.json > tmp/p0-47/red.log 2>&1
    p47_red=$?
    set -e
    test "$p47_red" -ne 0
    printf '%s\n' "$p47_red" > tmp/p0-47/red.exit
    # Only this disposable fixture's one probe source is restored. No main archive or manifest is touched.
    git restore --source "$p47_base" -- "$p47_source"
    npm run build > tmp/p0-47/restored-base-build.log 2>&1
    node scripts/snapshot-plan-edit.mjs --issue P0-99 --base "$p47_base" "$p47_source" > tmp/p0-47/snapshot.log 2>&1
    printf '\nexport const p47Probe = 1;\n' >> "$p47_source"
    npm run build > tmp/p0-47/green-build.log 2>&1
    npx --no-install vitest run $(git grep -l 'unused-code/' -- tests | rg '\.test\.ts$') --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/green.json > tmp/p0-47/green.log 2>&1
    git restore --source "$p47_base" -- "$p47_source"
    npm run build > tmp/p0-47/final-base-build.log 2>&1
  )
done
printf '%s\n' "$p47_runroot"
commands.note: The current script/helper/test copies are measured tooling overlay, not a current-main suite claim. Retain all four fixtures and receipts for review. Confirm each red report fails the source/declaration freeze assertions relevant to that probe and each green report is success=true with zero failed/pending/todo. Historical expected failures were 3,3,3,2; report fresh outcomes exactly. No existing registration is removed or rewritten.

commands.phase: Actual live-read helper mutation, current-main owned checkout only
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH"
p47_helper=tests/helpers/landedSource.ts
p47_backup=$(mktemp /private/tmp/amc-p0-47-landedSource.XXXXXX)
cp "$p47_helper" "$p47_backup"
trap 'cp "$p47_backup" "$p47_helper"' EXIT
python3 - <<'MUTATION'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/helpers/landedSource.ts')
s=p.read_text()
needle='if (!edit) return readFileSync(resolve(root, key));'
assert s.count(needle)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,'if (true) return readFileSync(resolve(root, key));'))
MUTATION
set +e
npx --no-install vitest run tests/planEditsManifest.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/live-read-helper-mutant.json > tmp/p0-47/live-read-helper-mutant.log 2>&1
p47_helper_red=$?
npx --no-install vitest run $(git grep -l 'unused-code/' -- tests | rg '\.test\.ts$') --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/live-read-parity-mutant.json > tmp/p0-47/live-read-parity-mutant.log 2>&1
p47_parity_red=$?
set -e
cp "$p47_backup" "$p47_helper"
cmp "$p47_backup" "$p47_helper"
test "$p47_helper_red" -ne 0
test "$p47_parity_red" -ne 0
trap - EXIT
commands.note: Inspect actual archive-vs-live failures, not process exit alone. No fs mock is involved. Repeat current-main passing checks after byte restoration.

commands.phase: Actual omitted-SHA helper mutation, current-main owned checkout only
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH"
p47_helper=tests/helpers/landedSource.ts
p47_backup=$(mktemp /private/tmp/amc-p0-47-landedSource.XXXXXX)
cp "$p47_helper" "$p47_backup"
trap 'cp "$p47_backup" "$p47_helper"' EXIT
python3 - <<'MUTATION'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/helpers/landedSource.ts')
s=p.read_text()
needle='    if (sha256(bytes) !== edit.sha256) throw new Error("Plan-edit snapshot changed: " + edit.archivePath);\n'
assert s.count(needle)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,'    // Qualification mutant: archive hash guard omitted.\n'))
MUTATION
set +e
npx --no-install vitest run tests/planEditsManifest.test.ts --testNamePattern 'throws when an archive no longer matches its manifest sha256' --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=tmp/p0-47/omitted-sha-mutant.json > tmp/p0-47/omitted-sha-mutant.log 2>&1
p47_sha_red=$?
set -e
cp "$p47_backup" "$p47_helper"
cmp "$p47_backup" "$p47_helper"
test "$p47_sha_red" -ne 0
trap - EXIT
commands.note: The selected tampered-archive assertion must fail because no error is thrown. Restore exact helper bytes, rerun helper/manifest positive checks, and verify all recorded source/archive hashes. No manifest entry is deleted or reassigned.
